title: Code Standards
scope_summary: Project-wide coding conventions for BoosterSimApp covering language/runtime constraints (Swift 6, macOS 15, no async/await), file organization (naming, size limits, MARK structure), concurrency rules (@MainActor, Combine), state management (services/AppStorage), design tokens, color/typography/icon guidelines, view composition, error handling, logging, memory management, accessibility, shell command routing, tab navigation pattern, and prohibited patterns.
